cases.answer: Pdfroo is Ayush's private PDF editor that runs entirely in your browser—no uploads, no backend. You can open a PDF, annotate, sign, rearrange or merge pages, and download a flattened PDF, all client-side using pdf.js and pdf-lib. It works offline once loaded and adapts to phones, tablets, and desktops with mouse, pen, or touch. The live demo is at [ayush4u.github.io/pdfroo](https://ayush4u.github.io/pdfroo/), and the code is on [GitHub](https://github.com/ayush4u/pdfroo). After a successful download, you get a little kangaroo toast saying your PDF never left your device—perfect for privacy-focused editing. No build step or install needed; just double-click index.html or serve it with any static server.
